items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-01-16
items.q: He picked up that name around when Clance William was down there... And he used to play it so well, you see, with Clance.

ctx.x: Known as Jelly Roll. Used to call him that. He picked up that name around when Clance William was down there, you see. He wrote a piece about, ain't gonna give nobody none of my Jelly Roll, you see. And he used to play it so well, you know, with Clance. And he just called him Jelly Roll Morton.
Did he sing at all, Charlie?
